title: Usefull Emerald
description: Make minecraft emerald a tad more usefull by adding weapon armor some custom item ect ...
body:
# **_Mak minecraft Emerald usefull._**

## Add a few extra use to minecraft emerald like :
- a emerald armor.
- an emerald tool set.

## Also add a new emerlad ore that give you :
- stronger emerald armor
- 2 new weapon
- 2 new enchants (1 for each weapon)
- 2 new block 9mostly here for decoration)
